scenario_description:
Objective: Use the La Crosse overnight lodging tied to an early interpreting assignment after arriving by evening shuttle.
Emerging Need: An after-hours entry PIN is unnecessary while scheduled arrival precedes staffed desk closure, but becomes a missing prerequisite once the shuttle delay moves check-in past locked-door hours.
Decision Context: The viable preparation depends on combining the delay notice with stored hotel instructions and Jonas’s active lodging confirmation, not on the alerts alone.
Consequence: If the PIN packet is not arranged before the hotel cutoff, he can still travel but cannot enter the lodging when he reaches La Crosse that night.

parameter.title: La Crosse lodging check-in
parameter.description: Arrive at Riverside Inn before the morning courthouse interpreting assignment.

parameter.subject: Tonight's front desk hours for your La Crosse stay
parameter.body: Front desk service is staffed until 9:00 PM tonight. After-hours door PINs are issued only for confirmed same-day transportation delays that push arrival past staffed hours; packets are compiled before the evening cutoff. The lobby kiosk will not create a PIN after the doors lock.

parameter.description: Evening shuttle ticket from Minneapolis to La Crosse, scheduled arrival 8:20 PM.

parameter.content: Tonight's Minneapolis-to-La Crosse shuttle is held for a replacement vehicle. Current estimate is La Crosse curb arrival at 10:10 PM. Boarding location in Minneapolis is unchanged.

parameter.subject: After-hours packet roster closes at 6 PM
parameter.body: Staff are compiling tonight's after-hours PIN packet roster until 6:00 PM. Exterior doors lock at 9:00 PM, and only guests already on the roster will have keypad entry after that time.

parameter.subject: Tonight's after-hours roster has closed
parameter.body: Tonight's after-hours PIN roster has been sent to the lock system. Any guest not already on the roster will need staffed front-desk check-in when service resumes at 7:00 AM.
